description: Who does this wallet transact with? Recent activity (~100 transactions) aggregated into a ranked counterparty list: address, explorer name where known, interactions in/out, total native value, first/last seen, methods used. The related-wallets answer from open data — honest about being a recent-activity sample. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.
